newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan thanked by Sri Lanka for donating dates.
- Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states "should copy Asian economies" - minister.
- Sudan "accepts UAE mediation bid" to help end the African country's conflict.t
- Bahrain's Labour and Social Development Minister Abdel-Nabi al-Shula to visit UAE later this month for talks to boost labour and social affairs cooperation.
- Dubai gold traders report brisk sales. Low prices, Eid shopping demand boost sales.
- Arab League gets copy of UAE complaint over Iranian violation of its territorial waters.
- UAE to discuss intellectual property rights agreement.
- GCC heading for graduate unemployment in 25 years.
- Arab league chief to visit UAE on February 21.
